description: This file defines the FulfilledPromise class, implementing the PromiseInterface. It models a promise that has already been fulfilled, providing methods to attach callbacks (then, otherwise), retrieve the value, check state, and ensure correctness when resolving or rejecting.

classes.name: FulfilledPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has already been fulfilled with a value, implementing PromiseInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the FulfilledPromise with a given value, throws exception if the value is or contains another promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches onFulfilled and onRejected callbacks. If onFulfilled is null, returns self; otherwise, schedules the callback execution.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches an onRejected callback to handle promise rejection.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Returns the fulfilled value or null depending on the unwrap parameter.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the string 'FULFILLED' indicating the promise has been fulfilled.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures the promise can only be resolved with the same value; throws exception if a different value is provided.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws an exception as a fulfilled promise cannot be rejected.
